Learned counsel for the appellant submits that the appellant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in this case.
It is submitted that date of birth of the victim is wrongly mentioned in the school record as 01.03.2006.
This fact is corroborated by P.W.1 father of the victim.
P.W.1, while giving his statement on 13.08.2024 admitted in cross- examination that his wife had died 20 years back.
At the time of death of his wife, victim was 3 years of age.
He had not prepared any birth certificate.
He further admitted that at the time of school admission, he had recorded the date of birth of the victim on the basis of estimation.
3. Similarly, it is submitted that the victim has admitted that the appellant had established physical relationship with her consent.
When NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:42578 3 CRA-13811-2024 victim had asked the appellant to take her back to her home, then he had brought her to the police station.
P.W.12, school teacher, admitted that there is no birth certificate in the school record.
He cannot state as to whether the date of birth was given by estimation or not.

4. As far as P.W.6 Dr. Alka Raul is concerned, she has stated that victim had informed her that when the appellant had expressed his affection towards the victim then on the second occasion, she accepted the proposal and then both had eloped together where they stayed together for six months.
There is a contradiction in this statement given to the doctor as well as the statement of the victim where she stated that physical relationship was established with consent.
D.N.A. report is positive but age of the victim is doubtful.
5. Learned counsel for the respondent/ State opposes the prayer and supports the impugned judgment.
6. After hearing learned counsel for the parties and going through the record, it is evident that the prosecution has failed to prove the age of the victim.

Father of the victim, in para 4 of his cross- examination, admitted that the victim's birth took place somewhere in the year 2001, therefore,
admittedly, the victim was a consenting adult in the year 2023 when the incident took place.
Though D.N.A. report is positive but age of the victim is doubtful.
7. Accordingly, the appeal is allowed.
The impugned judgment of conviction dated 27.11.2024 is hereby set aside.
Appellant is acquitted NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:42578 4 CRA-13811-2024 of the charges.
Appellant be released immediately, if not required in any other case.
8. Case property be disposed of as per the directions of the learned trial Court.
